sentence_stem: Although the report was published last year,
correct_completion: its conclusions are still widely cited.
full_sentence: Although the report was published last year, its conclusions are still widely cited.

options.text: so the findings were ignored by everyone.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, not a contrast. 'Although' requires a clause that contrasts with the first part.

options.text: its conclusions are still widely cited.
the report was written in English.
options.why_wrong: This adds a neutral fact about language and does not set up a contrast with the first clause.

options.text: the authors were asked to present it at a conference.
options.why_wrong: This describes an event but does not express the contrast that 'although' introduces.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' in passive reporting contexts
explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the concession. Learners from languages that rely on word order or coordination may add a neutral detail instead of a contrasting statement.
translation: Embora o relatório tenha sido publicado no ano passado, suas conclusões ainda são amplamente citadas.
